correctness.rationale: The frozen statement is for unlabeled packings as concepts on the 56-element spread universe. An independent exact-cover search using the nonzero binary vectors reconstructed 35 lines, 56 spreads and 240 packings: at either cover level selecting a block through the least remaining element enumerates every cover. Reproduction recovered compatible counts 56,840,4200,7560,5040 for k=1,…,5, with multiplicities 30,6,2, then 6720 single and 840 double completions, then all single. This supplies all trace estimates: for a four-set the three-positive pattern always fails if both triple completions contain the fourth spread and always exists if only one does. For each pair or singleton inside a compatible four-set, a union bound on completions involving forbidden spreads is smaller than the number of completions of the required positives, and the all-negative trace exists since 4·30<240. The same argument works on smaller compatible supports. Incompatibility loses the all-positive pattern. A shattered five-set would have a shattered four-subset whose unique completion already contains the fifth spread, which is impossible. Each compatible triple extends to a unique-completion quartet by taking a spread present in only one of its two completions, giving purity. The independent enumeration also compared direct trace masks on all compatible supports through k=5 and traversed the linear group action, recovering order 20160 and the orbit sizes 3360,3360 and 840. evidence: A compatible triangle of three lines uses six labels and admits a unique completion on each choice of seventh label; a concurrent triple uses seven and has two completions there. The four lines avoiding a point form the shared quartet of two completions interchanging the seventh and omitted labels. The other quartets have a unique completion.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: These cross-label completion facts can be derived from Fano incidence (for a triangle take the three pairwise intersections as a binary basis; for concurrency the remaining lines are one of two complementary parity selections). In particular the related triangle-facet count can be used to recover the 6720 unique completions by complementation and varying the omitted label. The local stabilizer also distinguishes the two types of complements, but the prior packing orbits alone say nothing about the stabilizer action on subsets. To obtain the global trace theorem still requires resolving the completion incidences, obtaining all negative patterns and higher-support obstructions, and relating local stabilizers or computing the actual support orbits. No compared theorem supplies those conclusions for this family.

value.rationale: A natural incidence concept class receives a complete local characterization, not just a numerical VC dimension. The criterion tells exactly when positive constraints force a forbidden spread, explains purity, and identifies two geometric facet types tied to distinct packing types. This makes the result a useful exact benchmark for trace questions on packing designs rather than a recomputation of the known packing census.
